project: TinyQV - RISC-V SoC with experimental pad setup
details: This version of TinyQV uses the new 3v3 standard cell library, 3v3 SRAM macros and a single line of pads to allow more area with fewer pins.  The extra space is used for 9.5kB of scratch RAM.  It also has a USB CDC peripheral which should allow serial comms without an external UART.
